name: FiMenuPresenter
tagline: Present F&I protection packages with payment impact, capture every decision and prove compliance.
description: A complete F&I menu app for dealerships: Platinum/Gold/Silver/Basic packages with monthly payment, increase and cost per day next to the payment without products; accept/decline per product with decline reasons; eligibility and price guards; disclosure checklist and typed signature before contracting; penetration, products per deal, PVR and compliance dashboards by F&I manager.
features: Package menu with payment impact and cost per day
Price guard between cost and list
Rule-checked status pipeline with drag & drop
Customer view hides cost and gross
Bulk assign, cancel with undo, CSV export
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
